description: This Java interface defines the OpenmrsData interface used within the OpenMRS project. It specifies common methods related to data objects, including deprecated methods for tracking changes, and extends other interfaces for auditability and voidability.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who changed the data, deprecated as of version 2.2.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who changed the data, deprecated as of version 2.2.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the data was changed, deprecated as of version 2.2.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the data was changed, deprecated as of version 2.2.
